input.summary: Convert the mutual no-hire into a narrow 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a no-hire covering all of the other party's employees, so we have limited this to a mutual non-solicitation of personnel directly involved in the services for twelve months after their involvement ends. We have also added the customary carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches.

ops.oldText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve months after the end of the relevant individual's involvement, neither party shall, and neither party shall permit its affiliates to, directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement. This restriction does not apply to general advertisements or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at such personnel, or to unsolicited approaches by any such individual, and neither party is restricted from hiring any person who responds to such general advertisement or makes such an unsolicited approach.
